exposure: Uterus manipulator (UM) application during total abdominal hysterectomy (TAH)
cohort: Forty-one patients aged 34 to 56 years undergoing abdominal hysterectomy for benign diseases were enrolled.
finding: Using a uterus manipulator in total abdominal hysterectomy significantly decreased operation time and blood loss compared to traditional TAH, with no difference in intra-and post-operative complications.
